name: Akira E. Ferrari
source: One of Neo-Venezia's Three Water Fairies, and a native of Aqua. As a Prima undine, Akira is called the "Crimson Rose" and is famed for her conversational skills. She has many admirers among her customers, especially the females, although she considers herself very feminine.
